evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive to discard knowledge delivered in flat imperative register — weariness or resignation in ordering erasure, low arousal and negative valence.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Second erasure directive in the same flat imperative tone — low-arousal negative affect, a settled instruction to purge information.
